durationSeconds.title: Seconds
durationSeconds.description: Extra seconds on top of the minutes (0–59).

soundOnZero.title: Beep at zero
soundOnZero.description: Plays a short beep when the timer reaches zero. Browsers only allow sound after the presenter has interacted with the slide.

zeroText.title: Text at zero
zeroText.description: Shown big when the timer hits zero, e.g. "Tijd!". Leave empty for none.

a11yTitle.title: Accessibility title
a11yTitle.description: Optional. Screen readers announce this when the slide becomes active. Prefer a short, descriptive phrase.

a11ySummary.title: Accessibility summary
a11ySummary.description: Optional extra context for screen readers (announced after the title). Keep it brief.

slideBgImage.title: Background image
slideBgImage.description: Optional. Fills the whole slide behind the content. Large images are resized automatically; use the focus control to pick which part stays visible when cropped.

slideBgOverlay.title: Background overlay
slideBgOverlay.description: Auto adds a subtle scrim only when the image is too busy for readable text. Gradient options darken one edge behind the text.

slideBgText.title: Text colour
slideBgText.description: Auto picks the theme text colour with the best contrast for the background image. Light/dark force it. (Legacy "default" is treated as the theme default.)

slideLogo.title: Theme logo
slideLogo.description: Show the active theme logo in a corner of this slide.
